journey.title: A tired evening
journey.purpose: Swap tonight's planned meal for something less effortful in a few taps, see the material effects, and keep groceries and leftovers coherent without changing permanent preferences.

steps.intent: See tonight's meal and decide it is too much work.
Open Swap meal and pick Less effort to rerank alternatives.
Review the impact on leftovers and groceries before applying.
See the grocery list reflect the swap as a reviewable change.

claims.statement: The swap works without choosing a reason, and a missing-ingredient reason never becomes a permanent dislike.
Every offered alternative still satisfies the required rules.
